MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The mounting tape felt like a natural next purchase because I already use double-sided tape and adhesive fasteners to attach parts in my projects.",
    "The glue fits my small repair work, provided it suits the materials, and the clamp meter fits my interest in inspecting and troubleshooting things with dedicated tools."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The pulley and air filters require specific projects or compatible equipment that my purchases do not establish; buying workshop tools does not mean I currently need lifting or compressed-air equipment.",
    "The thermostat and calibration weights serve different jobs from my thermometer and caliper. Measuring something does not mean I need automatic temperature control or scale calibration.",
    "The copper foil does not follow my recent fastening work closely enough, and the bulk sprayer nozzles do not match an established need or the dropper bottles I bought years ago."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My broad interest in workshop supplies seems to have been treated as interest in almost any specialized workshop accessory.",
    "Shared words or purposes such as bottles, measurement, and repair seem to have counted too much when the actual tasks and equipment requirements differ."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My repeated purchases of screws, bolts, rivets, rivet nuts, tapes, and fastening tools point most clearly toward assembling and securing materials.",
    "Recent, repeated project needs matter more to me than an isolated old purchase, and specialized accessories need a clear connection to equipment I actually use."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognized my practical repair interests but stretched them into specialized tasks that my recent purchases do not support."
}
